mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user_role SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_time = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = r.app_id AND a.code = 'workspace' AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.role_sort, r.id
